## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 is unsupported: the Strategy contains no Pieri expansions or integral row combinations for the nine listed partitions.
- claim-2 correctly identifies that \(\rho=(3,3)\) remains unresolved; therefore the required all-\(\rho\) certificate is not established.
- The cited antipode identity does not identify the two surviving terms or prove that every discarded term lies in \(A_+J\).
- Apart from the trivial \(\rho=\varnothing\) equality, no explicit identity with \(1\le t_k\le5\) and \(\bar s_{\lambda_k}\in J\) is supplied.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] For all ten \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), provide explicit integral identities
  \[
  R_{\rho'}-(-1)^{|\rho|}L_\rho
  =\sum_k a_kh_{t_k}\bar s_{\lambda_k},
  \qquad 1\le t_k\le5,\quad \bar s_{\lambda_k}\in J,
  \]
  including the zero boundary case, or give a complete specialized antipode derivation identifying the two surviving terms and disposing of every other term in \(A_+J\).
